name: expose a positional-arg CLI that writes a results json
definition: build a runnable script accepting fixed positional arguments (dataset, method, grid, reg, iterations, output) that writes a schema-shaped json containing names, counts, method, distance, timing, and reg.
failure_mode: malformed arg handling or json misaligned with the schema fails the pipeline tests

name: fill time-series gaps with linear interpolation plus boundary fallback
definition: replace empty cells in an hourly series via linear interpolation between nearest values, clamping to the first and last available values at the edges, and write the completed data back to the source file.
failure_mode: wrong boundary behavior or misindexed padding yields incorrect values at flagged positions.
